Context: 6. Permanent transfer to and from Central Autonomous/Statutory Bodies Counting of past service for pension

However, Public Undertakings, Nationalized Banks, RBI, SBI and its subsidiary Banks, LIC, General Insurance Corporation of India and its four subsidiaries are not treated as "Central Autonomous Bodies" for this purpose.
